author: Ryan Shirley
description:
Oman is one of the most incredible countries in the world! Enjoy this travel guide featuring Oman’s most beautiful places. From swimming in wadis, to camels roaming on the beaches, Oman is waiting to be experienced.  I recently returned from traveling across Oman and I want to share with you my favorite places & experiences. 

Oman Relaxation Film - https://youtu.be/h2EwkGz0m0I

Follow my buddy Walker on Instagram @evanhallfilms

Special thanks to @w.b.k.omani.guide for taking us to Wadi Hawer.
